title: [CQ-M07b] Daemon readiness evaluator for verified-local
description:
Slice of CQ-M07 (task-1a8f1d0e199046a289e94a5453d758b8). Design: mem:decision-cq-m07-verified-local-activation. Depends on CQ-M07a (task-5a635bc9), whose certification reader it consumes.

Objective: compute a readiness snapshot for verified-local from facts the daemon observes itself, never from anything a caller, a setting-as-grant, an env var, a persisted label or a project file can supply.

Deliverable: new packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/executionReadiness.ts plus its vitest file, exporting evaluateExecutionReadiness(deps) -> Promise of a frozen ReadinessSnapshot { ready, missingCapabilities: string[] (stable order), evaluatedAt, evidence: { reportSha256, platform, arch, providerVersion } | null }.
- Every input is injected (production defaults are wired in CQ-M07c):
  - CQ-M07a's certification result;
  - the LIVE Multipass version from this host's pinned client: read-only `version --format json`, the shipped platform module's pinned executable (never a PATH lookup), a bounded timeout. It must equal the accepted report's provider.version; a timeout, error or malformed output is a missing capability. No seat runs Multipass; the daemon is not a seat, and unit tests always inject the probe;
  - one named daemon-observed check per capability in today's list (executionProfile.ts): protected-host-control-plane (the daemon's own install real path is outside the project; MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED or any env var never counts), isolated-agent-and-qa-vms and isolated-check-vm (the accepted report's certify rows that prove them passed: name the check ids), authenticated-runner-evidence (this project's runner channel key exists, as server/runnerChannel.ts files it), revision-bound-local-delivery (settings.deliveryPolicy is 'local-branch'; a setting may only refuse here, never grant).
- Add ids for evidence failures (for example certification-report-missing, provider-version-mismatch) and keep one stable ordering; consumers (CQ-M07d's projection, IDE dialogs) list them verbatim.

NOT in scope: holding the snapshot, assertExecutionProfileReady, activationGaps and scheduling (CQ-M07c); the MCP and /ws projection (CQ-M07d).

Verification: the new vitest file in a git-archive snapshot with this task's files overlaid (cd <snapshot>/packages/moe-daemon && npm ci && npx vitest run src/delivery/executionReadiness.test.ts, under env -i with the nvm Node 24 PATH), never in the shared checkout.
definitionOfDone: With every injected fact present and matching, evaluateExecutionReadiness returns ready true and an empty missingCapabilities (vitest).
Each capability failing alone gives ready false with exactly that id; several failing list all of them in the stable order (vitest table).

A live version different from the report's, a probe timeout, a probe error and malformed probe output each give a fixed id; the fake probe records exactly the pinned executable path and argv `version --format json` (vitest).

MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 and other MOE_* or HOME env values, a readiness label persisted in settings or task JSON, and a valid report placed inside the project or .moe/ never make it ready (vitest rows).
The named vitest run passes in a git-archive snapshot.
taskRails: Unit tests never spawn a real Multipass client; the probe is always injected outside production wiring.
